name: Ramz | Modern Arab Currency Symbols
author: birunihq

sections.description:
Ramz | Modern Arab Currency Symbols is a specialized WooCommerce plugin designed for e-commerce stores in Saudi Arabia, UAE, and Oman. It replaces the traditional text-based currency symbols (like SAR, AED, OMR) with modern, professional vector symbols and web fonts.

Features:

  • Saudi Riyal (SAR): Replaces text with the “SAR” symbol in a modern Calligraphic style (SVG).
  • UAE Dirham (AED): Uses a custom Webfont to display the official Dirham symbol elegantly.
  • Omani Riyal (OMR): Supports the new official Omani Riyal symbol (SVG).
  • Full Customization: Control colors, size, and alignment via settings.
  • Hover Effects: Supports interactive animations (Rotate, Scale, Wobble).
  • SEO Friendly: Designed with performance and SEO in mind.
  • High Performance: Uses Inline SVG and optimized fonts for fast loading.
  • RTL Support: Fully compatible with Arabic and English layouts.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ramz-modern-arab-currency-symbols folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Ramz Currency to configure settings.
sections.faq:
Does it support other currencies?

Currently, it supports SAR, AED, and OMR. You can also upload custom symbols for any other currency via the settings panel.

Does this plugin affect site speed?

No, the plugin is lightweight and uses Inline SVG techniques to ensure optimal performance.
